pages.text: Yes. Use an empty Programmed Talisman, choose Hop, Dash, or Ray in Theorems, then Inscribe.$(br2)Normal use casts the inscribed proof. Sneak-use opens its resources; <- Proof returns to the programmer.

pages.title: First Witness
pages.text: Hop begins with a recommended preparation of 1 feather. Keep that feather in your inventory; it is a witness and is consumed only when the cast succeeds.$(br2)After inscription, the proof may already be ready. Open Resources to inspect its plan; it says Ready when graph, preparation, and inventory agree.

pages.title: From Proof To Effect
pages.text: Q.E.D. marks a proof confirmed on the talisman.$(br2)A successful cast answers with therefore: ∴ the proof takes effect.

pages.title: The Proof Seal
pages.text: The small seal beside the proof title reports its current state. Hover it for the exact diagnosis.$(br2)A teal turnstile means demonstrated; gold dots mean inscription is pending; a coral sum means witnesses are missing; a green square means cast-ready.

pages.title: A Small Proof
pages.text: Mathemagicians begin with small proofs because every premise, witness, and result can be inspected.$(br2)Master Hop from typed runes to world effect before composing longer conjectures.
